d:
Anirudh weaves absolute magic in ! In the mellifluous vocals of Pradeep Kumar & Shashaa Tirupati with endearing lyrics by Kabilan Vairamuthu and pleasing Carnatic interludes, this song is sure to leave you wanting for more.
Watch the official song video from .
Composed & Arranged by Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics - Kabilan Vairamuthu
Vocals - Pradeep Kumar & Shashaa Tirupati
Acoustic Guitars - Pradeep & Godfray Immanuel
Bass Guitar - Naveen Napier
Electric Guitars - Keba Jeremiah, Sajith Satya.
